jiuzhang1.label: Jiuzhang 1.0 (2020)

sampling_protocol.note: The 43-click count is postselected; the laser clock is not substituted for accepted unconditional throughput.

jiuzhang1_author_cov0.covariance_hash_encoding: C-contiguous float64 bytes after V*0.5+V.T*0.5; xxpp; hbar=2; vacuum=I
jiuzhang1_author_cov0.provenance_scope: Author-distributed unoptimized cov_0.npy, identified by the repository as Jiuzhang1 ground-truth covariance. Optical calibration and hardware sample mapping have not been independently reconstructed.

calibration_notes: Official complex transfer matrix already contains input phases and efficiencies. Do not apply loss a second time.
Official row order changes from interleaved H/V to all H followed by all V.
Mean 43 is for the paper's high-power setting, not every calibration in the data archive.

jiuzhang2.label: Jiuzhang 2.0 (2021)
jiuzhang2.source_architecture: 25 two-mode squeezed pairs, equivalent to 50 single-mode squeezed inputs
calibration_notes: Includes low-click datasets suitable for classical bridge experiments.
Correct the same H/V row-order convention before reconstruction.
Pump and programmed phases define different instances; a maximum 113-click event does not identify one complete target.

measurement.fanout_grouping: 8 binary bins per main optical mode
measurement.note: Eight fanout bins use two paths and four time bins; grouped counts are pseudo-PNR, not true photon numbers.

jiuzhang4_s64.label: Jiuzhang 4.0 S64 (2026)

reported_detection_statistics.note: 3050 is a reported maximum detection-event count in the largest configuration; subgroup means and maxima need their specific data.

sampling_protocol.note: The cited 25.6 microsecond interval is cataloged on L1024; a matched subgroup timing protocol has not been verified.

jiuzhang4_s64.topology: Three 16-mode interferometers linked by delay arrays; hybrid spatial/temporal modes; connectivity 4096, not a generic Haar circuit.
